ground_truth: In the bootstrap listener the PR replaces `bootstrapDone.next(); bootstrapDone.complete();` with `if (!bootstrapDone.closed) { bootstrapDone.next(); bootstrapDone.unsubscribe(); }`. `unsubscribe()` on a Subject does not complete it, so the initial navigation (with `initialNavigation: 'enabledBlocking'`), which waits on `bootstrapDone`, never completes and its `finalize` never clears the router's current navigation; later navigations (e.g. re-navigating from a component's init) misbehave. Fixed by completing the subject again and taking only one emission in the navigation transition.
